newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Everbright says to buy plywood firm.
newsitem.headline: China Everbright says to buy plywood firm.

text.p: China Everbright International Ltd said on Thursday it was in discussion to take a stake in a plywood products and timber boards producer in China.

The company said it was in talks with its 75 percent controlling shareholder China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd with respect to "a possible acquisition of equity interests in a Sino-foreign joint venture" in China.
"The discussion is still underway and no terms have been finalised and no binding commitment has been entered into yet," the company said.
The venture engages in production and sale of plywood products and other timber boards in China, it said.
China Everbright shares rose HK$0.24 or 27.59 percent to end Wednesday at HK$1.11 per share.
